desc: Correctly interpret both operations as reversible exchanges \(0^X1^Y \leftrightarrow 1^Y0^X\).
Use invariance of each numbered one’s position modulo \(X\) and each numbered zero’s position modulo \(Y\).
Establish that matching residue sequences for ones and zeros are necessary and sufficient for reachability.
Handle all edge cases, including \(S=T\), \(X+Y>N\), \(X=Y\), \(X=1\), and \(Y=1\).
Verify the implementation on both supplied samples.
